# Model compatibility matrix

<!-- Generated by `tq-forge compat --write`. Do not edit by hand: `npm test` fails when this file differs from the generator's output. -->

How every bundled skill and subagent template scores under the rules of each current Claude model. Model data is from `config/models.json` (updated 2026-11-13). The scores come from static checks: no model was called, so this shows that a file avoids what a model rejects or handles badly, not how well the model performs the task.

**27 of 27 artifacts pass** (18 skills, 9 subagent templates). The lowest score under any model is 90/100; the gate is 70. Linted again at `low`, `medium` and `high` effort under every model, no artifact loses a point.

## Models

| Model | ID | Role | API default effort | Routine | Agentic | Hardest | Stops early at | Thinking | Sampling parameters |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fable 5.2 | `claude-fable-5-2` | orchestrator | `high` | `medium` | `high` | `xhigh` | `low`, `medium` | always-on | rejected |
| Opus 5.5 | `claude-opus-5-5` | daily-driver | `medium` | `low` | `medium` | `xhigh` | none documented | always-on | rejected |
| Sonnet 5.5 | `claude-sonnet-5-5` | daily-driver | `high` | `low` | `medium` | `xhigh` | `low` | adaptive | default-only |
| Haiku 5.5 | `claude-haiku-5-5` | fast-worker | `medium` | `low` | `medium` | `high` | `low` | adaptive | default-only |

Each column is the current model of its family. Mythos 5.2 (`claude-mythos-5-2`, verified organizations only) shares the Fable column: same rules, same effort guide.

`Routine` is the level for chat and short, well-specified tasks. `Agentic` is the starting level for multistep coding and tool use. `Hardest` is worth its cost only where a gain was measured on your own tasks. `Stops early at` lists the levels at which the model is documented to end a long task before it is done; a long-horizon agent needs explicit completion instructions there (rule M011).

## How to read the recommendations

- **Score**: structural dimensions (1-10 each, averaged, times 10) minus the lint penalties of that model. 70 is the promotion gate.
- **Min tier**: the least capable tier the artifact is expected to run well on. A subagent template uses the model it pins. A skill gets one point each for writing files, using the web, asking the user a question, and a procedure of 8 or more steps: 0 points is Haiku, 1-2 is Sonnet, 3 or more is Opus, and a skill that starts subagents is Fable. This is an estimate from the file, not a measured result.
- **Effort**: the level a template pins, or for a skill the registry's `routine` level (0 points) or `agentic` level of its minimum tier.
- **Status**: PASS when the score is 70 or more under every model and the dry-test passes.

```bash
npx tq-forge compat --write    # rewrite this file
npx tq-forge compat --check    # exit 1 when it is out of date or an artifact fails
```
